I have farmed this land for many years the way my father and his father did before me. I keep cattle and goats, so I will spread their manure on this plot, but chemical fertilizer is too expensive and I do not trust it. I will plant the seed I saved from last season because it has always grown well here. My sons and I will do most of the work, but I will hire a few extra hands from the village when the weeds are heavy and during harvest.
